chunks: Zurarah said: Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام said:
"Beware of wrapping oneself in the manner of al-ṣammā’."
He said: I said, "What is al-ṣammā’ ?"
He said: "It is that you put the garment from under your arm and place it upon one shoulder."

key_terms.الثَّوْبَ: the garment or piece of clothing being worn
key_terms.الصَّمَّاءِ: a specific improper style of wrapping a garment

ai.seo_question: What does al-ṣammā’ mean in hadith about garments for prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a prohibition or discouragement regarding a particular way of wearing a garment, called al-ṣammā’. In context, it relates to rulings and etiquette concerning clothing, especially in relation to salat (prayer) and proper dress.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.796 – Zurarah narrated that Abu Ja'far, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) said:
I asked: "And what is the 'wrapped shroud'?"
Imam (as) said: "It is when you take your garment under your arm and place it over one shoulder”.
